thermodynamic_decay.title: Thermodynamic Pipe Loss in Heat Symbiosis
thermodynamic_decay.formula: T_delivery = T_ambient + (T_source - T_ambient) * exp(-U * pi * D * L / (m_dot * Cp))

variables.k: Heat decay coefficient (typically 0.0008 m^-1 for insulated pipe)

thermodynamic_decay.description: Calculates the thermal temperature drop of hot water piped from data center cooling loops to district heating or greenhouses over a distance L.

references.citation: Dalla Rosa, A., & Christensen, J. E. (2011). Low-energy district heating in future buildings. Energy and Buildings, 43(10), 2740-2750.
ASHRAE. (2020). Handbook—HVAC Systems and Equipment. Chapter 12: District Heating and Cooling.

discharge_cooling.title: Thermal Discharge Naturalization Distance

variables.L_natural: Required minimum distance to travel (meters) before discharging to natural water systems
variables.k_discharge: Natural cooling decay coefficient (typically 0.005 m^-1 under atmospheric exposure)

discharge_cooling.description: Calculates the distance needed for discharged hot water to return within environmental limits (ambient + 1°C) to prevent ecological damage to riparian ecosystems.

references.citation: Caissie, D. (2006). The thermal regime of rivers: a review. Freshwater Biology, 51(8), 1389-1406.
NSW Department of Planning and Environment (DPE). (2022). NSW Aquifer Interference Policy & Environmental Flow Guidelines.

pumped_hydro.title: Pumped Hydro Potential Storage Capacity
pumped_hydro.formula: E = eta * rho * V * g * delta_h / 3.6e9

variables.delta_h: Effective hydraulic head (vertical height drop, meters)

pumped_hydro.description: Determines the electrical energy storage capacity in megawatt-hours (MWh) utilizing the vertical drop from the ridge to the pit void.

references.citation: Blakers, A., Lu, B., & Stocks, M. (2017). 100% renewable electricity in Australia using pumped hydro energy storage. ANU Report.
Dams Safety NSW. (2021). Declared Dams safety standards and guidelines.

network_routing.title: Network Winding & Path Distance Factor

variables.D_network: True routing distance along road/path network (meters)
variables.D_linear: Linear Euclidean distance (as the crow flies, meters)
variables.W_factor: Winding topology factor (usually 1.35x for roads, 1.45x for active transport along contours)

network_routing.description: Models the actual walking/cycling or transport path distance along contours and road networks compared to straight-line Euclidean distance.

references.citation: AASHTO. (2018). A Policy on Geometric Design of Highways and Streets, 7th Edition.
Lake Macquarie City Council. (2021). Lake Mac Active Transport Strategy.

flood_inundation_risk.title: 1% AEP Flood & Coastal Inundation Vulnerability Model

variables.h_flood: Peak 1% AEP (1-in-100 year event) inundation depth on buildable pad (meters)
variables.is_floodway: Boolean flag indicating high-velocity dynamic flow path
variables.p_inundated: Percentage of total parcel footprint inundated (%)

classification_thresholds.low_mitigation: 0.0m < h_flood <= 0.3m -> Score 0.70 - 0.90 (Minor Pad Raising / Sheet Flow Mitigation)
classification_thresholds.hard_exclusion: h_flood > 0.8m or Active Floodway -> Score 0.00 (HARD EXCLUSION / Uninsurable Critical Facility)

flood_inundation_risk.description: Evaluates hydrodynamic flood vulnerability against 1% Annual Exceedance Probability (AEP) statutory flood surfaces and coastal storm tide extents to protect heavy electrical and mission-critical infrastructure.

references.citation: Ball, J., Babister, M., Nathan, R., Weeks, W., Weinmann, E., Retallick, M., & Testoni, I. (Eds.). (2019). Australian Rainfall and Runoff: A Guide to Flood Estimation (ARR 2019). Commonwealth of Australia (Geoscience Australia).
Smith, G. P., Davey, E. K., & Cox, R. J. (2014). Flood Hazard: Review of Australian and International Guidelines. Water Research Laboratory Technical Report WRL TR2014/07, UNSW Sydney.
Australian Building Codes Board (ABCB). (2022). National Construction Code (NCC 2022) - Building Code of Australia: Part B1 Structural Provisions & Flood Hazard Areas.

seismic_hazard_pga.title: National Seismic Hazard Assessment (NSHA) Peak Ground Acceleration Model

variables.PGA: Peak Ground Acceleration with 10% probability of exceedance in 50 years (500-year return period, in units of g)
variables.site_class: AS 1170.4 Site Subsoil Class (A: Strong Rock, B: Rock, C: Shallow Soil, D: Deep/Soft Soil, E: Very Soft Soil)

classification_thresholds.standard_code: 0.04g < PGA <= 0.08g (Class B/C) -> Score 0.80 - 0.95 (Standard Building Code Compliance)
classification_thresholds.elevated_risk: 0.08g < PGA <= 0.12g (Class C/D) -> Score 0.50 - 0.80 (Enhanced Structural Stiffening / Damping Required)
classification_thresholds.hard_exclusion: Site Class E (Liquefaction prone very soft soil) -> Score 0.00 (HARD EXCLUSION)

seismic_hazard_pga.description: Calculates earthquake vulnerability based on Geoscience Australia National Seismic Hazard Assessment (NSHA 2018) ground motion models and AS 1170.4 subsoil classifications.

references.citation: Allen, T. I., Griffin, J. D., Leonard, M., Clark, D. J., & Ghasemi, H. (2018). The 2018 National Seismic Hazard Assessment (NSHA18) for Australia: Model Overview and Hazard Results. Record 2018/17, Geoscience Australia, Canberra.
Standards Australia. (2007). AS 1170.4:2007 Structural design actions - Part 4: Earthquake actions in Australia (incorporating Amendments 1 & 2).
ISO/IEC. (2023). ISO/IEC 22237-3: Information technology - Data centre facilities and infrastructures - Part 3: Site seismic risk and structural suitability requirements.

cyclone_wind_hazard.title: Tropical Cyclone & Extreme Wind Hazard (TCHA & AS/NZS 1170.2)

variables.wind_region: AS/NZS 1170.2 Wind Region classification (Region A: Normal, Region B: Intermediate, Region C: Cyclonic, Region D: Severe Cyclonic)

classification_thresholds.region_a: Region A (V_R = 45 m/s, Non-cyclonic) -> Score 1.00 (Standard Building Envelope)
classification_thresholds.region_b: Region B (V_R = 57 m/s, Intermediate / Transition) -> Score 0.85 (Upgraded Tie-Downs & Bracing)
classification_thresholds.region_c: Region C (V_R = 69 m/s, Tropical Cyclonic) -> Score 0.50 (Impact-Resistant Cladding & Wind Loading Surcharge)
classification_thresholds.region_d: Region D (V_R >= 88 m/s, Severe Cyclonic / Western Australia Coastal) -> Score 0.20 (Major Structural Hardening Capex)

cyclone_wind_hazard.description: Quantifies structural wind hazard using Geoscience Australia Tropical Cyclone Hazard Assessment (TCHA) and AS/NZS 1170.2 standard wind velocity regions.

references.citation: Arthur, W. C. (2018). Tropical Cyclone Hazard Assessment 2018: Technical Report. Geoscience Australia Record 2018/20, Canberra.
Standards Australia / Standards New Zealand. (2021). AS/NZS 1170.2:2021 Structural design actions - Part 2: Wind actions.
Holmes, J. D. (2021). Wind Loading of Structures (4th Edition). CRC Press, Taylor & Francis Group, Boca Raton, FL.

landslide_slope_stability.title: Geotechnical Landslide Susceptibility & Slope Instability Model
landslide_slope_stability.formula: S_landslide = If(slope_pct > 8.0 or susceptibility in ['High', 'Very High'], 0.0, If(slope_pct <= 3.0 and susceptibility == 'Very Low', 1.0, Max(0.30, 1.0 - (slope_pct / 8.0) * 0.60)))

variables.slope_pct: Digital Elevation Model (DEM) topographic slope grade percentage (%)
variables.susceptibility: Statutory Landslide Susceptibility Class (Very Low, Low, Moderate, High, Very High)

classification_thresholds.very_low: Very Low Susceptibility & Slope <= 3% -> Score 1.00 (Optimal Solid Foundation)
classification_thresholds.low: Low Susceptibility & Slope 3% - 5% -> Score 0.80 (Standard Cut/Fill Grading)
classification_thresholds.moderate: Moderate Susceptibility or Slope 5% - 8% -> Score 0.40 (Geotechnical Retaining Required)
classification_thresholds.hard_exclusion: Slope > 8% or High/Very High Susceptibility -> Score 0.00 (HARD EXCLUSION / Active Slip Zone)

landslide_slope_stability.description: Evaluates ground stability against state statutory landslide susceptibility maps (GSNSW, QLD Resources, GSV) and terrain slope to eliminate unstable foundation pads.

references.citation: Australian Geomechanics Society (AGS). (2007). Landslide Risk Management Concepts and Guidelines. Australian Geomechanics, 42(1), 51-149.

Fell, R., Corominas, J., Bonnard, C., Cascini, L., Leroi, E., & Savage, W. Z. (2008). Guidelines for landslide susceptibility, hazard and risk zoning for land use planning. Engineering Geology, 102(3-4), 85-98.

bushfire_ember_attack.title: Bushfire Asset Protection Zone (APZ) & Bushfire Attack Level (BAL) Decay

variables.dist_veg_m: Distance from site boundary to classified bushfire vegetation (meters)
variables.bal_rating: Statutory Bushfire Attack Level (BAL-LOW, BAL-12.5, BAL-19, BAL-29, BAL-40, BAL-FZ)

classification_thresholds.bal_high: 20m <= dist_veg < 50m (BAL-29 / 40) -> Score 0.40 - 0.70 (Specialized Ember Screening & Water Deluge)

bushfire_ember_attack.description: Models wildfire exposure and defensible asset protection zones to protect critical cooling towers and backup generation facilities against catastrophic ember attack.

references.citation: Standards Australia. (2018). AS 3959:2018 Construction of buildings in bushfire-prone areas.
NSW Rural Fire Service (RFS). (2019). Planning for Bush Fire Protection (PBP 2019): A guide for councils, planners, fire authorities and developers. NSW Government.

data_depth_provenance_indexing.title: Multi-Tier Spatial Data Depth & Micro-Fidelity Indexing Framework

variables.Data_Depth_Score: Overall site spatial data depth and resolution score (0 - 100%)
variables.N_indexed_layers: Number of active spatial layers with verified local/regional geometry intersecting the candidate site
variables.N_total_target_layers: Target statutory baseline layers (Cadastre, Power Grid, Sensitive Receptors, Water/WWTW, Elevation DEM, Flood AEP, Seismic PGA, Cyclone Wind, Landslide, Bushfire = 10 layers)

fidelity_tiers.tier_1_high_precision: 100% (10/10) - High-Fidelity Micro-Data: Local 1m LiDAR DEM + Statutory LGA Flood Study + Site-specific Cadastre
fidelity_tiers.tier_2_regional: 80% - 90% (8-9/10) - Regional Spatial Model: State-wide GeoParquet + Geoscience Australia baseline overlays
fidelity_tiers.tier_3_continental: < 80% (<8/10) - Continental Baseline: NationalMap general interpolation fallback

data_depth_provenance_indexing.description: Explicitly communicates the spatial resolution, freshness, and statutory layer coverage for every candidate site so decision-makers can distinguish between high-precision micro-surveyed sites and regional baseline approximations.

references.citation: Intergovernmental Committee on Surveying and Mapping (ICSM). (2020). Elevation and Depth Foundation Spatial Data Guidelines. ICSM Canberra.

sigmoidal_sensitive_receptor_decay.title: Continuous Sigmoidal Buffer Decay for Social & Community Receptors

variables.d: Minimum Euclidean distance from parcel boundary to nearest sensitive receptor (meters)
variables.d0: Critical acoustic and safety compliance threshold distance (500 meters)

classification_thresholds.exclusion: d < 300m -> Score 0.00 (Hard Exclusion / Incompatible Land Use)
classification_thresholds.penalty: 300m <= d < 500m -> Score 0.20 - 0.50 (High Penalty / Acoustic Wall Required)
classification_thresholds.workforce_decay: d >= 5000m -> Linear decay down to 0.70 at 15,000m (Commute Accessibility Penalty)

sigmoidal_sensitive_receptor_decay.description: Prevents land-use conflicts with schools, hospitals, and residential zones using EPA acoustic setback standards while maintaining workforce accessibility within regional commuting bands.

references.citation: NSW Environment Protection Authority (EPA). (2017). Noise Policy for Industry (NPfI).
Standards Australia. (2018). AS 1055: Acoustics—Description and measurement of environmental noise.

dem_slope_filtering.title: Digital Elevation Model (DEM) Topographic Slope Suitability

variables.Threshold: Max 5.0% for heavy data center slab foundation construction

dem_slope_filtering.description: Evaluates ground grade from Geoscience Australia ELVIS DEM. Slopes > 5% trigger heavy earthmoving cost penalties or build exclusions.

references.citation: Geoscience Australia. (2023). ELVIS Elevation Foundation Spatial Data Framework.

cadastre_lotplan_querying.title: National & State Cadastral Lot/Plan Identifier Framework

variables.Plan_Type: Plan classification (e.g. DP, SP, RP, PS)

cadastre_lotplan_querying.description: Standardizes multi-jurisdiction cadastral attributes from Geoscape, NSW Cadastre, QLD DCDB, Vicmap, and Landgate SLIP to enable lot/plan and address querying.

references.citation: Intergovernmental Committee on Surveying and Mapping (ICSM). (2020). Cadastral Spatial Data Model (CSDM).

multi_hazard_resilience_score.title: Multi-Hazard Statutory Resilience & Climate Risk Framework
multi_hazard_resilience_score.formula: S_hazard = G_hazard * (0.30 * S_flood + 0.25 * S_seismic + 0.20 * S_wind + 0.15 * S_landslide + 0.10 * S_bushfire)

variables.G_hazard: Binary exclusion gate (0 if active floodway >0.8m, liquefaction class E, slope >8%, or BAL-FZ <20m; 1 otherwise)
variables.S_flood: Hydrodynamic 1% AEP Flood depth score (ARR 2019 / NCC 2022 Part B1)
variables.S_seismic: Seismic ground motion Peak Ground Acceleration (PGA) score (AS 1170.4:2007 / GA NSHA 2018)
variables.S_wind: Extreme wind and tropical cyclonic design gust velocity score (AS/NZS 1170.2:2021 / GA TCHA 2018)
variables.S_landslide: Geotechnical slope stability and landslip susceptibility score (AGS 2007 Guidelines)
variables.S_bushfire: Bushfire ember attack and Asset Protection Zone (APZ) buffer score (AS 3959:2018 / NSW RFS PBP 2019)

classification_thresholds.wind: Region A (<=45 m/s) -> 1.0; Region B -> 0.85; Region C (69 m/s) -> 0.50; Region D -> 0.20

data_depth_indexing.tier_1_high_precision: 10/10 layers (100% data depth) — Certified 1m LiDAR and local hydrodynamic models
data_depth_indexing.tier_2_regional_model: 8/10 layers (80% data depth) — Regional interpolation and state-scale hazard contours
data_depth_indexing.tier_3_national_baseline: 6/10 layers (60% data depth) — Continental baseline approximations

multi_hazard_resilience_score.description: Quantifies natural hazard exposure against statutory Australian building codes and international ISO/IEC 22237 Tier-IV mission-critical infrastructure standards.

references.citation: Ball, J., Babister, M., Nathan, R., Weeks, W., Weinmann, P., Retallick, M., & Testoni, I. (Eds.). (2019). Australian Rainfall and Runoff: A Guide to Flood Estimation (ARR 2019). Geoscience Australia / Commonwealth of Australia.
Standards Australia. (2007). Structural design actions, Part 4: Earthquake actions in Australia (AS 1170.4:2007, R2018). Standards Australia, Sydney.
Allen, T. I., Griffin, J. D., Leonard, M., Clark, D. J., & Ghasemi, H. (2018). The 2018 National Seismic Hazard Assessment: Model overview. Geoscience Australia Record 2018/17.
Standards Australia / Standards New Zealand. (2021). Structural design actions, Part 2: Wind actions (AS/NZS 1170.2:2021). Standards Australia / Standards New Zealand.
Arthur, W. C. (2018). Tropical Cyclone Hazard Assessment (TCHA 2018). Geoscience Australia Record 2018/20.
Australian Geomechanics Society (AGS). (2007). Guideline for Landslide Susceptibility, Hazard and Risk Zoning for Land Use Planning. Australian Geomechanics, 42(1), 13-36.
Standards Australia. (2018). Construction of buildings in bushfire-prone areas (AS 3959:2018). Standards Australia, Sydney.

ISO/IEC. (2021). Information technology — Data centre facilities and infrastructures — Part 3: Site suitability and environmental conditions (ISO/IEC 22237-3). International Organization for Standardization.

composite_mcda_siting_score.title: 6-Factor Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis (MCDA) Composite Siting Score
composite_mcda_siting_score.formula: S_composite = G_total * (0.30 * S_power + 0.25 * S_hazard + 0.20 * S_sensitive + 0.15 * S_water + 0.10 * S_size)

variables.G_total: Composite feasibility gate (0 if hard excluded on sensitive receptor, slope >5%, or hazard gate; 1 otherwise)
variables.S_sensitive: Sensitive receptor sigmoidal decay buffer score (20% weight)
variables.S_water: Recycled wastewater cooling proximity score (15% weight)
variables.S_size: Scalable net developable pad size score (10% weight)

composite_mcda_siting_score.description: Synthesizes multi-domain geospatial constraints into an actionable 0-1.0 suitability index supporting real-time client-side What-If scenario modeling.

references.citation: Malczewski, J. (2006). Ordered weighted averaging with fuzzy quantifiers: GIS-based multicriteria evaluation for land suitability analysis. International Journal of Applied Earth Observation and Geoinformation, 8(4), 270-277.

gladstone_perfect_score.title: Gladstone Perfect Score Resolution
gladstone_perfect_score.text: Gladstone scores high in power and water infrastructure because its candidate parameters fit within optimal industrial bands. However, incorporating the Tropical Cyclone Hazard (Region C design wind speed of 69 m/s) properly introduces statutory wind engineering mitigations (S_hazard = 0.872), providing realistic cross-state differentiation.

data_source_provenance.title: Data Source Provenance and API Ingestion
data_source_provenance.text: To prevent real-time WFS/FeatureServer REST API connection timeouts during Spark runs, all datasets (NSW Rail, Energy grid, and pathways) are ingested and hosted as optimized Cloud Spatial Iceberg tables on Wherobots. This ensures high-performance distributed Sedona queries while maintaining full data volume tracking.
